crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither…
Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a…
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me…
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

translations.web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
translations.bsb: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
translations.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
translations.asv: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.
